about.subtitle: About me
about.paragraph1: I have always loved taking photos — initially just for myself and my loved ones, but eventually, this passion turned into a profession. I completed photography training, made it to the TOP-5 best participants of the course, and received a diploma.
about.paragraph2: Today, I create photographs that don't just look beautiful, but preserve your stories, feelings, and moments you want to return to.
